contracts: Every supported Acceptance route is present, accessible, and resolves to its declared package target.

Test-author entry: scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s4.py. Create real tests for every assertion in this slice, using @pytest.mark.cer_assertion for exact assertion IDs. Read the actual production behavior and bound oracle. Never create unconditional RED, skip/xfail, empty cases or prewritten execution receipts. Missing markers are authoring work; only an actual probe decides present/missing.
selector_intents: Remove or point a declared supported Acceptance package route at an unavailable target and verify route validation fails.

Run the mapped cases against the unchanged real production owner. Required observable: The route-validation result lists every supported Acceptance route with successful availability and target resolution. Required result: All declared supported Acceptance package routes resolve successfully and remain accessible through the route validator. Emit CER-A-4FA80D37FB75-BEHAVIOR only immediately before a genuine assertion failure demonstrating this unmet behavior. Do not emit it for setup/import/timeout/missing-marker failures, and do not force already-present behavior to fail.
